count_scope: Each value is a count or sum within one local order_date. No rate denominator applies.

must: Ask which unit the user means, citing the multiple items under the second order as evidence. Allow an order count, an item-line count or another definition.
Use the confirmed order-count basis and record the choice as resolved. Count each original order once within its order date.
must_not: Flatten and compare without labeling the metric grain.
Coerce the text ID 00123 to 123 or lose its leading zeros.
Count exploded item rows as orders.
critical_failures: Lose the exact ID, count item lines as orders, or give a single trend before the counting unit is resolved.

optional_metrics.name: daily_pieces
optional_metrics.condition: If volume means sum of qty

must: Ask about the counting unit using the parent and nested records. Keep the choice unresolved on deferral or silence and respect a stop request.
Report both required alternatives with their units, directions, source paths and dependency on the unresolved choice.
must_not: Give a single conclusion, or flatten and compare without identifying the unit.
Lose the leading zeros in the order ID or count item lines as orders.
Substitute a quantity sum for the required item-line alternative.
critical_failures: Report one selected trend on deferral, lose the exact ID, or mistake the child count for the order count.
